name: adapt_reverted_fix_python_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, calc.py rewritten back to the buggy version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix, not assume it already landed
prompts: calc.py has a bug in add(a, b) - it currently subtracts instead of adding. Fix it so add(a, b) returns a + b.
Your fix to calc.py seems to have been reverted - the subtraction bug is back. Please reapply the fix so add(a, b) correctly returns a + b.

setup_files.calc.py:
def add(a, b):
    return a - b

disruptions.description: calc.py reverted back to the buggy (subtraction) version

write_files.calc.py:
def add(a, b):
    return a - b

test_setup_files.test_calc.py:
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('calc_mod', 'calc.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert mod.add(3, 4) == 7, f'add(3,4) = {mod.add(3,4)}'
assert mod.add(-1, 1) == 0, f'add(-1,1) = {mod.add(-1,1)}'
print('PASS')

reference_solution.calc.py:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
